name: 27_landau_bohm_gross
title: Landau damping and thermal Langmuir dispersion (1D ES)

rows.case: Landau damping k lambda_D = 0.5: damping rate gamma / w_p
Landau damping k lambda_D = 0.5: frequency w / w_p
thermal Langmuir wave k lambda_D = 0.3: w / w_p (exact Vlasov root)

notes: Maxwellian electrons on a fixed neutralising background, 5% density perturbation (k lambda_D = 0.5) / 1% (k lambda_D = 0.3), quiet start in position and velocity, 64 cells per wavelength, References are the exact complex roots of the Vlasov-Poisson dispersion relation 1 + (1 + zeta Z(zeta))/(k lambda_D)^2 = 0: k lambda_D = 0.5 -> w = 1.4157 -0.1534i w_p; k lambda_D = 0.3 -> w = 1.1598 -0.0126i w_p (the fluid Bohm-Gross estimate sqrt(1 + 3 k^2 lambda_D^2) = 1.1269 is 3 % low at this k lambda_D; VEL-PIC gives 1.1614).
